statement: theorem regret_tuned_distance (V : Domain (E := E)) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (hx₁ : x₁ ∈ V.carrier) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (D G : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D) (hG : 0 < G) (hloss : ∀ t < T, SubdifferentiableOn V (loss t)) (u : E) (hu : u ∈ V.carrier) (hdist : ‖x₁ - u‖ ≤ D) (hgrad : ∀ t < T, ‖currentSubgradient (loss t) (iterate V (fun _ => D / (G * Real.sqrt T)) loss x₁ t)‖ ≤ G) : regret V (fun _ => D / (G * Real.sqrt T)) loss x₁ u T ≤ D * G * Real.sqrt T
